text: No, there was no tree-cover loss on this property in 2026. The latest available data (as of November 2026) only covers up to 2025, and the observed tree-cover loss occurred in that year (13.5 ha, or 3.91% of the asset). No further changes were detected in 2026, and the assessment remains pending corroboration due to the lack of a later year in the series. The 2025 loss was confirmed by multiple sources (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, and MGAP 2021), but no additional changes were recorded afterward.
